tagline: Lalor's Trusted Electrician - On Time, Every Time
aboutSubheading: Local, licensed and always on time
aboutText: With over 20 years of electrical experience, Your Local On Time Services has been Lalor's trusted licensed electrician for years. Billy and his team specialise in switchboard upgrades, house rewiring, EV charger installation, and 24/7 emergency callouts across Melbourne's northern suburbs. We hold REC 24551 and ensure all work meets Australian safety standards. Our promise is simple: arrive on time, every time, with honest pricing and a clean workspace.
servicesSubheading: Expert solutions for your home and business
servicesText: From routine inspections to complex rewiring, we cover all electrical needs in Lalor and surrounds. Our licensed team provides switchboard upgrades, EV charger installations, and emergency repairs with a focus on safety and reliability.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: We upgrade old switchboards to meet current safety standards, preventing electrical hazards in your home.

services.title: House Rewiring
services.desc: Complete rewiring services for older homes, ensuring safe and efficient electrical systems throughout.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: Professional installation of electric vehicle chargers for residential and commercial properties.

services.title: Smoke Detector Compliance
services.desc: Installation and testing of smoke detectors to comply with Victorian regulations and keep your family safe.

services.title: Security Camera Installation
services.desc: Expert setup of security camera systems for enhanced surveillance and peace of mind.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Services
services.desc: Round-the-clock emergency callouts for urgent electrical faults in Lalor and northern Melbourne.
